#VA10 families can save an average of over $900 a year on premiums thanks to our Inflation Reduction Act.

#GetCovered today! https://t.co/U6oFfIgDHP

NEW: I led my colleagues in urging @GovernorVA to take additional action & prepare for Medicaid unwinding.

Thanks to our #InflationReductionAct, Virginia seniors on Medicare now won’t pay more than $35 a month for their insulin.

No one should have to choose between lifesaving medication or putting food on the table.

I’m proud we’ve finally delivered on this longstanding priority. https://t.co/cviXuVCLGj

A record number of Americans have enrolled in an affordable health insurance plan for this year—and thanks to our work in Congress, your options are cheaper than ever.

There's still time to find coverage that works for your family. Visit https://t.co/wt5qIKPA49 today.

Seniors on Medicare are now paying only $35/month for insulin.

But House Republicans want to take us backwards—introducing legislation to repeal the sweeping provisions in our #InflationReductionAct which are lowering drug costs.

We can't let them win.
https://t.co/OmGgivLbGC

NEW: More than 36,400 Virginia Medicare beneficiaries are paying less for their insulin this year thanks to our #InflationReductionAct.

They're saving an average of $510 annually with the new $35/month cap—just one of the ways we've lowered health care costs for #VA10 families.

This is a big deal for Virginians who rely on lifesaving insulin.

We put the pressure on Big Pharma, and we're seeing the results. Capping insulin costs at $35/month for Medicare beneficiaries was a major part of our Inflation Reduction Act—and now millions more will benefit.

.@POTUS' new plan would keep Medicare fully funded without cutting benefits or raising taxes on anyone making less than $400k/year.

But if extreme Republicans get their way, Medicare is on the chopping block & seniors will pay more for their prescriptions.https://t.co/LIL4L1A7j9

.@POTUS' robust & sensible budget builds on our progress to lower costs, create jobs, boost business, & support a strong economic recovery.

It's time for the House GOP to stop hiding their plan to gut Social Security & Medicare while handing out tax breaks to the ultra-wealthy.

Today marks 13 years of the Affordable Care Act enabling millions of Americans to access affordable, lifesaving care and protecting those with preexisting conditions.

I've fought in Congress to build on the ACA, and now more Americans have health insurance than ever before.

This is a disastrous and dangerous decision which could end insurance coverage for critical care like cancer screenings, contraception, HIV and STI screenings, and more for millions of Americans.

This is a flawed ruling and must be challenged.
https://t.co/6cW42gdpMD

Mifepristone has been proven safe & effective for decades.

But now an extremist judge is trying to recklessly undermine FDA's scientific approval process. I'm fighting back & joining this effort to keep the drug accessible for those seeking abortion care.
https://t.co/muvYmDdfo3

Attention #VA10 Medicaid recipients—the end of COVID-19 pandemic emergency policies means you may be at risk of losing coverage.

https://t.co/vLAb6tSxCZ

I’m grateful to @SecBecerra for joining me last week to meet with #VA10 seniors at @BirminghamGreen and talk about how essential Medicaid is in the community.

Make sure you don't lose your Medicaid! During the Medicaid unwinding process, you may have to take action to renew your coverage.

Check out the helpful tool below to find out when you can expect your notice to renew, if applicable. ⬇️
https://t.co/KPL5skrsjZ

I was proud to vote to pass the #InflationReductionAct to finally empower Medicare to negotiate drug prices and save Virginians money.

By taking on Big Pharma, we're making it more affordable to treat diabetes, heart disease, arthritis, cancers, and more.

Big news for #VA10 seniors—we're reining in the skyrocketing costs of prescription drugs.

This is big news! When we passed the Inflation Reduction Act, we took on Big Pharma and won by finally empowering Medicare to negotiate drug prices.

Now, thanks to our work in Congress, #VA10 seniors are saving money on their prescription drugs.
